newsitem.title: KENYA: Police arrest 12 in Kenya's worst bank theft.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest 12 in Kenya's worst bank theft.

text.p: Kenyan police said on Wednesday they had arrested 12 people in connection with the theft of $1.64 million from Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Ltd in Kenya's biggest ever bank robbery.
"Police in Nairobi are questioning 12 suspects in connection with the robbery," a police spokeman said.
Six thieves took $900,000 and 40 million shillings ($740,700) after entering through a staff entrance at the bank before opening hours, bank spokesman Juma Muiru said after Tuesday's robbery.
Muiru said the bank, robbed twice last year for up to $22,200, wrote to the commissioner of police last July to express concern over security.

The East African Standard newspaper reported that "even hardened cops were staggered by the audacity of the heist, which one described as mafia-style" -- referring to the five-minute operation in which no single shot was fired.
